children: New Delhi, Oct. 6 -- A Tata Group stock, Trent, rose 10% to hit its upper circuit in early deals on the BSE on Tuesday, 6 October, a day after the company reported the business update for the September quarter of the financial year 2026-27 (Q2FY27). Trent share price opened at Rs.2,800 against its previous close of Rs.2,575 and surged 10% to the upper price band of Rs.2,832.50. It extended gains later to touch an intraday high of Rs.2,901.20, surging nearly 13% during the session.

In an exchange filing on 5 October, Trent said its Q2FY27 standalone revenue from operations stood at Rs.5,788 crore, rising 23% year-on-year (YoY), while for the first half of the year (H1FY27), revenue rose 21% YoY to Rs.11,454 crore.
Revenue from the sale of merchandise, excluding other operating income, also grew by 23% and 21% during the quarter and the half year ended September 2026, respectively, said the company.
During the quarter, the company opened its 1000th Zudio Store and as of 30th September 2026, its portfolio stood at 1,342 stores across Westside, Zudio and other lifestyle brands.
During the quarter, it opened 10 Westside stores and 17 Zudio stores.
Trent shares have been in the red for the last three consecutive sessions, cumulatively losing nearly 3%.
In the last six months, however, they have gained 11% compared to a 2% drop in the equity benchmark Sensex and an 11% jump in the BSE Consumer Discretionary index.
Trent shares hit a 52-week high of Rs.3,399.75 on 3 July after hitting a 52-week low of Rs.2,185.16 on 30 March this year.
As per the June quarter shareholding pattern data, mutual funds held 7.81 crore shares, equivalent to 14.64% stake in Trent.
Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) is a major stakeholder, holding 1.61 crore shares, or 3.03% stake in Trent, by the end of the June quarter.
Foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) cumulatively held 8.08 crore shares, or 15.14% stake, in the company.

Among promoters, Tata Sons Private Limited held 17.3 crore shares, or 32.45% stake, while Tata Investment Corporation Limited held 2.3 crore shares, or 4.28% stake, in the company by the end of the June quarter.
According to Vipin Kumar, AVP-Research at Globe Capital Market, the current chart structure is sideways, facing immediate moving average resistance at the Rs.2,965 spot level.

"A decisive close above this resistance zone could drive the stock toward the Rs.3,150 level in the medium term. Conversely, a sustained drop below Rs.2,780 spot could drag it back into the Rs.2,600- Rs.2,650 spot range, filling the gap left open today," said Kumar.
